facts.query: Blue whale vs a school bus by weight
facts.topic: Blue whale vs school bus weight
facts.explanation: The blue whale is the heaviest animal known to have ever lived. An adult can weigh as much as many school buses put together, and even an elephant looks small next to it. Weights vary a lot between individuals, so these are typical values.
